field_evidence.description: Change of use of land associated with existing dwellinghouse (Use Class C3), erection of a single-storey building to create five Supported Living Accommodation units (Use Class C3(b)), & erection of ancillary building and associated works
field_evidence.explicit_main_building: single-storey building to create five Supported Living Accommodation units

geometry_limitation: Official planning page exposes no machine-readable application point or building footprint; GeoJSON geometry is null and no location geometry was inferred.
identity_limitation: The source explicitly states one single-storey supported-living building and one ancillary building. Five accommodation units are internal programme within the one main building, not five distinct buildings; the existing dwellinghouse is excluded from new-building count.
evidence_slice: Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council planning application RB2026/1290 at 146 Morthen Road Wickersley: application received 11/09/2026 and registered 15/09/2026; the official public planning page states no decision and describes change of use of land associated with an existing dwellinghouse, erection of a single-storey building to create five Supported Living Accommodation units, and erection of an ancillary building. This batch counts exactly two distinct planned buildings: the explicitly stated single-storey supported-living building and the explicitly stated ancillary building. The five accommodation units are within the one stated single-storey building and are not counted as five buildings; the existing dwellinghouse is not counted as new. The official page exposes no machine-readable application point or building footprint, so no geometry is inferred.
